user.title: Adaptive Light
user.description: A zone, or the outdoor radiation used when a zone has no lux sensor.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: One zone, on its own. When someone is present, these lamps turn on when the weighted average of the lux estimate over the window is below the threshold, and turn off when that average rises above the threshold. Newer samples weigh more. A falling average does not turn them off. The window defaults to 10 minutes. Threshold 0 follows presence only. When all sensors have been off for the timeout, the lamps turn off. The groups below set the color, the brightness, the hours when the zone is active, and night mode. Turn on Use these hours to stop the zone turning lamps on or taking shared lamps outside its windows. Each window is a numbered group with From and To. Fill the next empty group to add one. Groups are ordered by start time. Off, or an empty list, means always. A window may cross midnight. Night mode is separate: inside its own window, lamps turn off after the still period with no movement and turn on again when movement returns. Another zone is added as another entry.

color.name: Color
color.description: Red, green, and blue, each from 0 to 255, and a Kelvin slider. Hold color sends RGB when any box is filled, otherwise Kelvin, and tells Adaptive Lighting not to change the color.

brightness_level.name: Brightness
brightness_level.description: Level from 0 to 255, and whether this zone holds it.

active_hours.name: Active hours
active_hours.description: Turns every window on or off. Each window is its own numbered group below, with From and To. Fill the next empty group to add a window. Saved groups are ordered by start time, including an overnight window. Off, or no groups filled, means always active.

data_description.active_hours: Off keeps the zone always active, even when groups are filled. On uses every group, including one that runs overnight.

group_1.name: Group 1
group_1.description: From and To for this window, the same time fields as Night from and Night until. Leave both empty to skip the group. Fill the next empty group to add a window.

outdoor.title: Outdoor light
outdoor.description: Used when a zone has no lux sensor. The estimate is outdoor radiation in W/m² times this factor. An empty sensor leaves those zones on presence only.

momentary.title: Momentary action
momentary.description: On trigger the lamp's current state is saved, the color is applied, and after the duration the snapshot is restored or the lamp turns off. A sensor or button trigger already stored on this action is kept.
